outcome: length of hospital stay after cesarean delivery
cohort: Mothers who underwent cesarean delivery in southern Ethiopia were included in the study.
finding: The average post-cesarean hospital stay was 2.71 days, with shorter stays associated with younger maternal age, closer hospital proximity, first antenatal booking, lower income, health insurance, and counseling, while extended stays were linked to severe pre-eclampsia, multiple births, and postoperative complications.
